name: osgames2
what: v3's games workflow with the run-line, registered beside osgames under its own name; its id is what its own Chainlink reporter fixes. The addresses are the deploy's: the reporter as planned on 11 Nov 2026, before the registration, from the deployer's address and a salt through the CreateX factory's deployCreate3 (not from a nonce); the games set, the workflow owner, the secret owner (the same wallet) and the payout wallet are the live workflow's. The route is the run-line table's Data API URL. The committed template keeps its placeholders; this spec sets every value over it, and names the owner
